d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how, as the 75th Miss Universe pageant gets underway in San Juan, Puerto Rico, sweeping US presidential travel restrictions are casting a heavy shadow over the global celebration. Originally designed as a vibrant showcase of international culture and women’s empowerment, this year's competition has hit a major roadblock for several top African contestants. Strict visa bans enacted under recent policy orders have directly forced countries like Zambia and the Republic of Congo to withdraw their historic representatives, including Mubanga Pamela Hatyoka…
